markdownArticle.content:
# How an AI Phone Call Assistant Supports Home Service Teams

An AI phone call assistant is built to answer every call your home service business receives, using your script and rules. It can book appointments, send follow-up texts, and log call details, so you never miss a lead. This guide shows how an AI phone call assistant fits into daily operations and supports your team.

Published by Revo, which sells an AI receptionist for home service businesses. Reviewed November 19, 2026.

## How Calls Are Answered and Managed
When a customer calls your business, the ai phone assistant answers right away, using your preferred greeting and script. It can handle questions, gather information, and ensure every caller feels heard. All calls are logged, and summaries are created automatically, so you always know what happened on each call.

## Booking Appointments and Following Up
The ai phone assistant can book appointments directly into your calendar, following your rules for availability and service types. After the call, it sends a confirmation and follow-up message by SMS. This keeps customers informed and reduces no-shows, while freeing up your team from scheduling tasks.

## Connecting Your Team and Staying Organized
For businesses that need more, the ai phone assistant can transfer calls to your team, connect with field service software, and provide call recordings and transcripts. This helps your team stay organized, ensures nothing is missed, and makes it easier to manage customer relationships.

## Where Revo fits
Revo answers the calls you forward to it, 24/7, and follows your script and rules. It books appointments, sends SMS follow-up and logs a summary of every call. On Crew and Fleet it can transfer calls to your team and connect to your field service software. Solo is $175/month, and new accounts pay half price for the first 3 paid months ($87.50/month). You can start with your next 10 calls answered free, no card needed. [See Revo's plans](/pricing)

## Frequently asked questions
### Can the ai phone assistant give quotes or prices to callers?
No, it does not provide quotes or prices. It follows your script and books appointments, but pricing is handled by your team.
### Does the ai phone assistant assign technicians to jobs?
No, it does not assign technicians. It books appointments and logs call details, but scheduling specific staff is done by your team.
